summary: Reproduced cleartext api_key, admin_api_key, and ssl_keyfile_password disclosure through the actual /server_info handler. Added a positive allowlist diagnostic projection that redacts unreviewed present values by default, reapplies redaction after runtime overlays, and prevents the newer launch_command field from echoing unreviewed CLI or Engine argument values. The operational ServerArgs object remains unchanged.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction through the actual async server_info handler: all three configured credential sentinels appeared in the response. Raw output: reports/j-32261d3de89d/failing-before.txt

Passing-after coverage for configured and unset credentials, operational-record preservation, unknown-field default redaction, launch-command redaction, and runtime-overlay redaction. Raw output: reports/j-32261d3de89d/passing-after-focused.txt

Broad regression run: 272 passed and 2 unrelated existing context-parallel tests failed because this prepared interpreter reports HIP, where prefill CP is deliberately rejected. Raw output: reports/j-32261d3de89d/regression-suite.txt
All applicable server-info and ServerArgs regressions: 272 passed, 2 explicitly deselected, 70 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-32261d3de89d/regression-suite-applicable.txt
Changed Python modules and regression test compile successfully.

tests.what_was_measured: Repository formatting, lint, AST, credential-pattern, CI-registration, and other configured hooks all passed.

remaining_limitations: GPU execution was not performed because the disclosure and fix are deterministic Python projection/HTTP-handler behavior before model execution; no GPU kernel, model forward pass, or numerical claim is involved.
No full model server was launched and no model weights were used; the regression invokes the repository's actual async /server_info handler with the established no-socket TokenizerManager fixture.
The two excluded broad-suite cases exercise deprecated prefill context parallelism and fail only because the prepared ROCm platform rejects that feature before their asserted non-HIP behavior.

The open upstream candidate PR 37499 was inspected but deliberately uses a credential-name denylist/classification guard; this implementation instead follows the issue requirement that unknown future top-level ServerArgs fields redact by default.
